body:
So before I even start I just need to say psilocybin is such a powerful chemical that shouldn't be taken lightly, even at a low dose one should always be prepared for what is about to happen and never underestimate what this substance can do. This trip wasn't good, but it wasn't bad. It wasn't a learning experience but it wasn't a pointless high. It was the strangest thing I ever had happen that I'm gonna try and put in the best words as possible from what I can remember.
I've always been interested in substances that can help ones body and mind and I'll leave it at that, not being a fan of drugs at all as I don't see them helping anyone especially because of seeing what they can do to the people around me. I stick to anything natural ,especially when it comes to my health. I've smoked pot heavy through my teenage years, I've done salvia once or twice and done mushrooms a few times not having any serious effects, also never doing more that 2g (which I realized now was some weak mushrooms) and drink heavy on the weekend.
The past few months I've been interested in growing mushrooms which started out as button mushrooms for the nutrition, than psilocybe cubensis came shortly after. As my first time I didn't follow the correct colonizing/ fruit temperature causing them to grow insanely slow. After growing a heavy yield of psilocybe huautla which felt like it took months and selling a few grams to friends I decided it would be time to try own my grow. The plan was to have my friends do them with me at night around the fire pit in the woods by my house where we always hang out and drink. I figured it would be a great setting because of how much fun we always have and also growing up in these woods my whole life I feel very comfortable. But as the time comes, some of them back out because of work and girlfriends, and it's just me. So I figured why do them alone, so I figure I'll just drink instead (it was Saturday).
It ends up being me and 5 friends M,A,M,D,T. M and A were originally going to do mushrooms with me but end up doing 2 hits of acid each instead. It was me who hyped them up about tripping and after them hearing I'm not doing mushrooms now they make a big deal because I disappointed them and a little while later I said fuck it I'm gonna take 1 mushroom just to feel good (this mushroom I took was maybe a gram at most) and to see how what I waited so long for was. My mind was in a great place. I got paid from my job Friday, nothing was bothering me. All in all I was in a good mood. Thinking how I'm only taking around 1 gram the worst I'm gonna get is a mood change and maybe a few patterns on the floor (I haven't ate in maybe 4 hours) and I'd also drink a few beers. So we got our cooler and I got my backpack (hoodie, water, black and mild cigar, mini wheat cereal, banana) and went up to the woods.
So we get to our spot and I eat this little mushroom. After maybe 20-30min like usual I start getting very clear headed and trees look so nice. I also start getting the happy grin on my face and get waves of tingling in my arms and legs. But as time goes on I also start feeling nauseous which I'm trying to ignore. So I started looking out in the break of trees near our spot at the sky because the sun is almost completely down and I start seeing a purple orange blend of colors. I'm thinking there's no way I'm actually tripping (I still don't know if it was real) because of how little I took and how little time has passed so I call M over who's starting to come up on his acid and we spend maybe 10 min staring at the sky mind blown about how nice it looks still not sure if the sky is this actual color or I'm tripping already. But then, I started to get sick, which comes on very fast, and I started to dry heave over in the grass.
After this I'm still feeling nauseous and I start tripping hard, fast. My pupils are huge and my body feels like a feather, I keep waving my arms which are getting this tracer effect looking like 4 arms are following my one and I'm mind blown. My eyes feel bugged out and feel very opened up like I can see everything. Also my legs are like jello (because I've been standing the whole time) and I cant stand well, which I thought was hilarious and start having a laughing episode. Aside from still feeling sick, it's all fun from here but I'm still coming up for some reason as everything starts to feel warped.
After maybe 10 minutes of sucking on ice cubes from the cooler hoping the water would ease my stomach I just feel out of it. I start feeling very strange in my head like I'm not tripping, which is crazy because I know I'm wrecked but I keep saying it shouldn't be this intense. After getting a little overwhelmed and not being able to walk straight T and D have to hold me up as I attempt to grab a bud light lime (which I didn't even want) and the frosted mini wheat cereal I forgot. I had hoping maybe eating and some alcohol would calm me down. They bring me over to my seat and I tell them light the fire. This is where my night got ruined. I start getting scared with the feeling in my head that's creeping up. I'm also not hearing a word any of my friends are saying and I'm trying to string together sentences which feels impossible. I'm looking around sitting cross legged not sure if this is how I want to sit and it goes like this for a few hours of undecided feelings.
I start getting scared with the feeling in my head that's creeping up. I'm also not hearing a word any of my friends are saying and I'm trying to string together sentences which feels impossible. I'm looking around sitting cross legged not sure if this is how I want to sit and it goes like this for a few hours of undecided feelings.
I start to get bugged out at everything and I also start staring into space. By this time it's pitch black and I'm still coming up. The light from the fire in front of me starts getting too bright causing these 'sun streaks' in my eyes that makes me bury my head in my hands with these streaks lasting a few seconds with my eyes closed. All of a sudden out of nowhere, it feels like when I get hit in the head and see stars or when I stand up too quick and get dizzy. This is what my brain feels like the rest of the night and it just won't stop. My eyes also feel different, half my left eye on the top in my vision is blurry and my right eye vision looks like I'm looking through a broken mirror in fractals that are completely clear, but I'm seeing the same thing that's in front of me in. Now I'm thinking I fucked myself this time, now I start getting scared!
All I can remember for the next hour is getting these traveling lights every time I look at the fire. Every time I look into the darkness I would still see light which would get stuck in my brain. I'm also being stuck in conflict with myself about whether I should take a drink of my beer or eat a frosted mini wheat. At this time, I light my black and mild so now I have 3 things in front of me on top of these traveling lights and two different fields of vision and this leaves me sitting for I don't even know how long, just debating on what I want. My cigar keeps going out because I can't decide if I want to smoke. Every time I light it, it falls out of my mouth burning holes in my hoodie. While also trying not to have a full blown episode about what my brain feels like also on top of this. I'm telling myself I have a good life, friends, I'm a good person trying to calm down. I keep telling myself it's just the psilocybin doing this on top of light streaks in my eyes which are now giving me a feeling like I'm about to sleep.
I then look out into the trees hoping to stop my thoughts and get my mind on other things. The trees I'm looking at (it's completely black out) start morphing and spiraling into this huge 'Spider god' with glowing eyes and webs coming to get us. I'm looking at it and as my mood changes from scared to totally accepted of it being there. I look at it like it's a normal thing and go back to looking at the fire again and swear I shifted my seat a few feet to the left, which leaves me confused as hell, then look back at my 'spider god' which is still there. Now baby spiders are climbing around everywhere and I stare in amazement. Every time I look at the fire, I keep feeling like I'm shifting, and when I look back the spiders are closer. Out of nowhere, I get energy to stand up and grab a stick out of the fire. I start walking back and forth (still unable to stand), pretending like I'm a wizard and using it as a walking stick. It's completely on fire except for where I'm holding. I feel magic in the thing because of the fire and I start pretending to blow stuff up by slamming it on the ground like I'm the wizard of this forest. These spiders behind me are the monsters who need to get through to try and defeat me. It almost gives me a feeling like I'm playing the skyrim video game.
Now I start getting over being scared and I feel fucking insane. My pupils are huge, I got bags under my eyes, everything around them and my eyes themselves are beat red and I got a sick smirk on my face. I still feel like I got punched in my head and I'm dazed. D is drunk at this point and for some reason takes his shirt off which causes me to take mine off so I now I have no shirt. I look insane. I start talking to myself, (don't remember taking off my hoodie which is littered with burn holes). I leave my wizard walking stick burning on the floor and start walking around looking for firewood and throwing it in, blocking out what my friends are saying to me. I'm talking to the plants around us thinking they are hanging out around our fire with us.
After standing next to it, so proud of the fire I created (which thinking back to it I'm shocked didn't burn down our woods), I go over to M and A who are in full acid peak. I start mumbling and babbling to them trying to talk, they somehow understand what I'm saying and start babbling back and we talk for how long I don't remember but I keep saying 'mushrooms win'. (dont ask why) I feel like I beat them in a race of psychedelics and we argue about this and they keep saying acid wins. This causes another hysterical laughing fest which makes me feel weird with the feeling in my brain and I stop real quick and get this feeling of how pointless it was for me to laugh and just like that, literally within a few seconds, my mood is killed.
Then comes this feeling of 'damn we are high' and for a few minutes, I'm staring at M and A trying to visualize what they are going through. M then wants to smoke weed but forgot his grinder, so he's asking around who is ok to break it up. Because he said he wasn't, I said I'm ok and he gives me his weed which is changing colors as I'm pulling it apart. I feel so confident in how I'm breaking it up and I feel like I'm doing such a good job it turns into my mission to finish. I start talking like I'm doing surgery on this weed and everything around my peripheral vision is morphing and changing except for the the pot which is now different shades of green and orange. He then rolls it up and a few minutes later, yelling at me about how many stems are sticking out of his blunt. The bud was on the tail end of the plant with a big stem in the middle. It turns out I didn't break up anything and almost dropped half of it everywhere! I find this hysterical and start laughing like I did it on purpose. After this we just sat by the fire as I slowly come down within the next hour or so.
After I stop getting visuals, I'm fine now still feeling a little dazed. I still feel out it like I smoked a shit ton of weed. I didn't smoke. With a clear head I feel like this the rest of the night. I'm able to walk fine, I feel like I got my ass kicked but I start drinking what I had in our cooler and not getting drunk at all. I don't remember what happened to my bud light lime or cereal, or banana I had in my bag.  A few other friends come and meet us and it's all good aside from still feeling weird this is the rest of the night.
After going home I call my cousin who's trying to calm me down cause I have no explanation on how this tiny ass mushroom I ate fucked me up so bad. He tells me a story about something similar that happened and the feeling in my head was probably blood pressure from getting a little overwhelmed from the visuals I wasn't expecting. It just made me tweak out the rest of the night cause of what psilocybin does mix with my slight panicking. After trying to go to sleep (I'm wide awake but tired if it makes sense), I get this feeling every time I breath like I'm sucking in way too much air. It goes like this until I eventually fall asleep, waking up to feeling great with not the slightest feeling in my head like I did a drug/ medicine whatever you want to call it.  I end up going fishing and having a great day without the slightest hangover.
This is the best I can do putting my experience into words. Their are things I left out that I don't really know how to write but for the most part this is how my trip off of 1g went. Will I ever do mushrooms again? Yes. In the day time, I think the night has too much space for the mind to wonder. Do I have words for what I experienced off of such a small little dose? NO
The only thing that stayed with me is knowing I have good family and friends and being happy with my life, which was the one thing that stood out. It's been a few weeks and now I'm laughing about what happened the whole night. If there's one thing I learned is, if you're gonna mess around with mushrooms, never think of it as something to take lightly.
